_about: Real session descriptions from headless Firefox and WebKit as Playwright 1.55.1 installs them (firefox-1490, webkit-2203): one RTCPeerConnection offers a data channel labelled osm-live-v1, a second answers. mdns-on: the engine's default; mdns-off: Firefox with media.peerconnection.ice.obfuscate_host_addresses off and ice.loopback on (WebKit never hides here); turn-and-stun: a loopback node-turn server (turn udp, stun) configured; relay-only: the same with iceTransportPolicy relay. cross: each engine answering another's offer (Chromium is chromium-1194), host addresses in the clear. Regenerate by repeating that walk; nothing here is secret (throwaway keys, loopback and TEST-NET addresses).
